newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime outfits Shell U.S. platform.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime outfits Shell U.S. platform.

text.p: Norwegian offshore group Aker Maritime ASA said its U.S. yard, Aker Gulf Marine in Texas, had begun outfitting the topsides for the Ram Powell tension leg platform for Shell Oil.
The unit is destined for the Viosca Knoll area of the Gulf of Mexico and is due to be ready for departure in May.
Five modules were already in place and installation of process equipment and instrumentation was underway, the company's Pulse newsletter said.
Ram Powell lies in about 980 metres of water and is designed to produce 60,000 barrels per day of oil and 200 million cubic feet per day of gas.
Aker Maritime is majority-owned by industrial group Aker RGI ASA.
